name: Seahorse Divers Barbados
summary: A small dive shop by the entrance to St Lawrence Gap, run by dive leader David Hutson, who has more than 30 years in the industry. There is one boat trip each morning with two dives on south coast reefs and wrecks, in groups of up to six certified divers or three beginners. Bookings are by email or WhatsApp message, and payment is cash only.
standouts: Owner David Hutson has been in the diving industry for over 30 years
Small groups: maximum 6 certified divers or 3 Discover Scuba divers per trip
18 south coast dive sites listed, including the six wrecks of Carlisle Bay Marine Park
Private and small group diving trips

contact.address: St. Lawrence Main Road (Highway 7), Christ Church, Barbados

trips.title: Certified Divers
trips.summary: A morning boat trip with two dives for certified divers, on south coast sites such as the Carlisle Bay wrecks, Friar's Craig, Castle Bank and The Muff. Groups are kept to six divers. Single dives, same-day two-tank dives and packages of up to ten dives are offered, plus a short refresher.
highlights: Two dives each morning, Monday to Saturday
Maximum of 6 certified divers per trip
Sites include Carlisle Bay Marine Park, Friar's Craig, Castle Bank, Mount Charlie and The Muff
Transport back to the hotel offered in select areas

trips.checkNotes: Cash only, no credit card facilities. Bookings by email or WhatsApp message only (messages, no calls, to 1-(246) 824-6352); the page also has a booking request form. durationMinutes worked out from the stated 8:30am departure and return 'around 12:15pm'. No night dives, no certification courses or referral dives, no Nitrox. The site advises cruise ship passengers they cannot make the 7:30am meet time unless on an overnight ship.

trips.title: Discover Scuba
trips.summary: A first dive for beginners with no certification. It includes a lesson, a practice session and one dive, or two dives on the same day with the +1 Dive option. Groups are limited to three people.
highlights: Option to add a second dive the same day
Maximum of 3 Discover Scuba divers per trip
